primitives.note: Hemorrhage stacks (0-5) applied/refreshed by damaging attacks and abilities, read by R to scale its true damage and to trigger Noxian Might at 5 stacks.
Every damaging basic attack or ability application adds/refreshes a Hemorrhage stack on the target (the trigger mechanism for the DoT stacking, not a flat bonus damage number itself).
Hemorrhage bleed: per-stack physical damage ticking over a 5s duration (bin tick interval 1.26s vs wiki's stated 1.25s).
Noxian Might: bonus AD for 5s, granted when Darius applies 5 Hemorrhage stacks to the target or kills it with R.
Q's blade/handle AoE damage resolves after its wind-up; R's true damage resolves on cast/leap.
0.75s wind-up before the swing, during which Darius cannot basic-attack or cast E/R; can be cancelled by dash/stasis.
Crippling Strike arms the next basic attack within 4s with bonus AD-ratio physical damage (crit-affected).
The empowered attack from Crippling Strike resets Darius' basic attack timer.
W: killing with the empowered attack halves its cooldown and refunds cost. R: killing shortly after the hit resets the recast window (free recast within 20s, permanent at rank 3).
R has a free recast within 20s of a successful execute, refreshing on further kills.
R's true damage is increased 20% per Hemorrhage stack on the target, capped at 100% bonus at 5 stacks.
Mana costs on Q/W/R (E has no damage payoff so is unlikely to be cast) can gate how often abilities are recast inside 15s at low mana pools.

needsBespoke.why: Darius' kit maps onto the primitive list: a stacking target debuff feeding a DoT and a conditional-damage execute, an empowered on-hit attack with a reset, and cooldown refund/recast mechanics. E's passive armor penetration is a flat stat modifier to the standard physical-damage formula (not a kit-specific mechanic) and needs no bespoke logic; E's active deals no damage in these sources and is treated as a non-damage utility skill.

unsettled.question: Is the Hemorrhage bleed's tick interval 1.25s (wiki description) or 1.26s (bin's SecondsPerTick), and does this change how many ticks land within the 5s duration / interact with refreshes?
Do the Hemorrhage bleed's own damage ticks count as 'abilities dealing damage' that add/refresh another Hemorrhage stack, or only the initiating attack/ability cast applies/refreshes the stack?
options: Only the initiating hit (attack/ability cast) applies or refreshes a stack; ticks are pure DoT payout
Each DoT tick also refreshes/re-applies a stack, extending duration indefinitely while ticking

unsettled.question: When R's true-damage bonus scales 20% per Hemorrhage stack, does that 20%/stack multiply the entire Damage term (RBaseDamage + 0.75x bonus AD) as the wiki's per-stack row implies, or is the per-stack bonus computed only against RBaseDamage with bonus AD scaling separately?
options: 20%/stack multiplies the whole Damage value (base + 0.75x bonus AD), matching wiki's per-stack figures (0.2 base, 0.15 AD)
20%/stack applies to RBaseDamage only, with bonus AD scaling handled by a separate unlisted term

unsettled.question: Does Crippling Strike's dual tagging (basic damage + spell damage) mean its single hit is treated as two separate damage/on-hit trigger instances for item and passive procs, or one damage instance that merely satisfies both trigger conditions?
options: One damage instance that triggers both on-hit and spell-effect conditions
Two logically separate procs (on-hit set + spell-effect set) off the same single damage number

options: Hemorrhage does not proc on-hit/spell-effect item passives (treated as a non-proccing DoT)
Hemorrhage procs spell effects once on application

proposal: Open with Q (Decimate): no cast-time delay but a 0.75s ghosted wind-up before the AoE blade damage lands and applies a Hemorrhage stack.

Weave basic attacks in every available window; use W (Crippling Strike) on cooldown to empower the next attack with bonus AD-ratio damage and reset the attack timer, chaining another auto immediately after.
Recast Q every time its (short, 5-9s) cooldown is up as a filler AoE hit that also refreshes a Hemorrhage stack.
Skip E (Apprehend) entirely: its active deals no damage against a stationary target already in range, and its cast/lockout time would only delay damage-dealing casts.
Once the target reaches 5 Hemorrhage stacks (via autos/Q/W), Noxian Might triggers, granting bonus AD for 5s; use this window to land as many autos/W procs as possible before casting R.

Cast R (Noxian Guillotine) once stacks are near/at the 5-stack cap so its true damage gets the full 100% stack bonus; if it would finish the target, its free recast is irrelevant in a single sustained-health dummy fight but note the recast is available for 20s if a kill is registered mid-simulation.
Continue autos/W/Q on cooldown for the remainder of the 15s, re-casting R again as soon as it comes off cooldown if the fight is still ongoing.
questions: At what champion level and with what attack speed/AD stats is this fight run, since that determines how many autos land between ability casts and how quickly 5 Hemorrhage stacks accumulate?
Should R be cast as early as possible (lower stack bonus, but starts its long cooldown sooner for a possible second cast in 15s) or held until 5 stacks for the full 100% bonus?
Does Q's 0.75s wind-up block basic attacks in a way that should be scheduled around ongoing auto-attack timers, or can it be weighted purely by cooldown availability?
Is E ever worth casting solely to guarantee closing distance/keeping the target in range, even though it deals no damage, or is the dummy assumed always in range so E is a pure loss?

Should Crippling Strike (W) be reserved to fire immediately as R comes off cooldown (to front-load Noxian Might's buff before the big true-damage hit), or fired purely on cooldown regardless of R's timing?
